blacklistabilityReview.evidence:
VBILL is a Securitize-administered VanEck fund token, with permissioned transfers restricted to KYC-onboarded institutional holders. On 2026-10-19, direct per-deployment reads measured 48695619.069655001163 total outstanding tracked share units: avalanche: 706864.040000000037 shares / 1.451597% at block 97944378 (2026-10-19T06:17:04+00:00); bsc: 21626229.800000000745 shares / 44.411038% at block 128504754 (2026-10-19T06:17:05+00:00); ethereum: 22098781.729655001312 shares / 45.381458% at block 26224774 (2026-10-19T06:16:59+00:00); solana: 4263743.500000000000 shares / 8.755908% at slot 458730399. The denominator is the sum of token totalSupply / mint supply across every catalogued deployment (Aptos ConcurrentSupply for ACRED), not missing census USD market cap, and is not an independent reconciliation of fund NAV liabilities. Material deployments are bsc, ethereum; sub-10% deployments are disclosed but do not set the verdict. bsc@128504754 (2026-10-19T06:17:05+00:00): owner()=0x59c1eacec450c57dcb9b8725d0f96635c2b676ee; getDSService(1)=0x079864f3dab043382f3cab4683fcb2aaa56894a4; trust.getRole(owner)=1 (MASTER); EIP-1967 implementation=0xcd01d1c5c78ad428cd01913d4664c20ed1e61923. https://bscscan.com/address/0xcd01d1c5c78ad428cd01913d4664c20ed1e61923

ethereum@26224667 (2026-10-19T05:55:35Z): owner()=0x59c1eacec450c57dcb9b8725d0f96635c2b676ee; getDSService(1)=0x08b9c1f3e2f236890b975dee37ee3579a0d4516b; trust.getRole(owner)=1 (MASTER); EIP-1967 implementation=0xaf88485377cca5e690e7dcb1ba81370f0b575156. https://eth.blockscout.com/api/v2/smart-contracts/0xaf88485377cca5e690e7dcb1ba81370f0b575156

Current verified DSToken source has onlyTransferAgentOrAbove seize(from,to,value,reason), onlyIssuerOrTransferAgentOrAbove burn(who,value,reason), and ServiceConsumer allows MASTER for both; no holder allowance required. These are present holder-targeted functions with current nonzero authorized callers, not just an admin's ability to add future burners. Ordinary transfer compliance is also permissioned, but active seizure/arbitrary-holder burn/freeze is sufficient for Yes. No declared parent is needed. Declared reserves are 100% custodial fund shares; that upstream exposure is secondary and does not supersede the direct Yes verdict.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: VanEck and Securitize's launch disclosure identifies VBILL availability on Avalanche, BNB Chain, Ethereum and Solana, with cross-chain interoperability enabled by Wormhole. Wormhole's own announcement identifies it as VBILL's official interoperability provider. The reviewed route rows describe issuer-native issuance; they do not establish that all cross-chain movements use off-chain transfer-agent re-issuance. The sampled Ethereum redemption receipt contains only VBILL token logs, which establishes the absence of a Wormhole message in that transaction rather than across every transfer path. VBILL-specific Wormhole manager, peer, validator, limit and administrative-control identities remain unresolved in the reviewed evidence.
